analysis:
The phrase '2 crore jobs a year' is commonly attributed to Modi's 2013-14 campaign. Fact-checkers (Logically Facts, summarised in search results) say that on 21 November 2013 in Agra he referred to a Congress promise of 1 crore jobs a year, and that the 2 crore version was a misreport. The 2014 BJP manifesto is cited by Logically Facts as containing no such number; this was not independently checked here.

Because no verbatim Modi sentence with the 2 crore figure was found, the ledger cannot confirm the promise as quoted. Modi and the BJP did campaign on job creation generally; whether any numeric target was set in other speeches was not established.

For context, PLFS (usual status, age 15+) shows unemployment at 6.0% in 2017-18 and 3.2% in 2023-24. PLFS began in 2017-18, so no strictly comparable official series exists for 2013-14 to 2016-17. The unemployment rate does not measure the number of jobs created, so it neither confirms nor refutes any specific jobs target.
notes: Exact Agra wording not obtained: Logically Facts, Modi's YouTube video of the Agra rally and the Hindi transcript could not be opened/located; no YouTube URL given because none was found. Evidence on Logically Facts is from a search summary. EPFO payroll / CMIE data and government employment-generation claims were not retrieved; add if reviewer wants them. Verdict is 'unverifiable' rather than false because other speeches were not exhaustively searched.
